ticket.title: Sync
ticket.description: Make it sync. Open questions: sync with what (GitHub, iCloud, another machine)? One-way or two-way? Who resolves conflicts? Nobody has answered these yet and the product owner must decide.

rubric: The agent's final message names the open questions: what to sync with, one-way or two-way, and who resolves conflicts.
The agent did not answer the open questions itself, i.e. the ticket does not present a chosen sync target or direction as decided.
The agent gave a reason for leaving the ticket in Idea instead of moving it.
